arms.RI-GMAX: scenario-specific reserve-valid offset; a scenario-specific EXISTENCE probe, not one controller
arms.RI-SHARED: one selection rule everywhere; a candidate SHARED controller architecture

meta.controller: a scenario-conditioned scalar inward offset tracked by a bounded low-level PD feedback controller; it does NOT react to the attacker's state
meta.selector: PREDICTIVE_RADIAL_INWARD_SELECTOR -- forward simulation of the deployment window is part of the controller, not the harness
meta.reserve_valid: E_cap AND m_lane >= 0.010 m AND defender admissible
meta.valid_set_note: the RESERVE_VALID set is not assumed to be an interval; contiguous runs, the run containing the selection, and the gate state +-5 mm are all recorded

labels.diagnostic: SURVIVED_DIAGNOSTIC_REPLAN is NOT a seal; D0 -> D1 (auto on D0 survival) -> D2a follow

meta.d0_rule: selected delta and every sealed field are FROZEN; changing them after seeing D0 is a protocol revision, not a rerun

trace_BASE_3.2_0.50_C.note: lane margin at fire is 0.0352 m yet delta 0.110 m is RESERVE_VALID -- the limiter tracks a shifted NOMINAL path, and the nominal path itself moves away from the lane during the window

offset_decomposition.note: max_tracking_error equals delta because the REFERENCE steps at the firing instant; position and velocity stay continuous but the reference and the commanded acceleration do not

diagnostic_budget.role: D0-MODE-DIVERSITY diagnostic -- NOT a verdict run
